svg.title: Foundry and Foundry Field
svg.desc: Foundry — Location not recorded — Links operating records across systems while preserving sources, definitions, dates, and changes.; Foundry Field — Location not recorded — Software for production tracking, maintenance, reconciliations, and operating exceptions.; Operations — Location not recorded — Tracks production, haulage, plan variances, and current operating conditions.; Maintenance — Location not recorded — Connects equipment, work orders, downtime, and production effects.; Reconciliation — Location not recorded — Reconciles mine, plant, laboratory, inventory, and financial records.; Exceptions — Location not recorded — Flags conflicting records and definitions for human review.
